s: Select the matrix → Home → New calculation (or right-click the visual) to open the visual calculations editor.
RUNNINGSUM without Reset never restarts; with HIGHESTPARENT it restarts at each top-level row (Category).
PREVIOUS is blank on the first row because there is no previous row on the axis.

code.title: The four visual calculations
src: Pct of parent = DIVIDE ( [Net Sales], COLLAPSE ( [Net Sales], ROWS ) )
Running per category = RUNNINGSUM ( [Net Sales], HIGHESTPARENT )

mod-viscalc-0.check: Running on the last row = visual total; vs Previous blank on row 1; Pct of parent sums to 100% per category; HIGHESTPARENT restarts per category.

s: Shared definitions and anything used for slicing or filtering → model measures (YoY %, rank, Margin %).
Layout-dependent, single-visual calculations → visual calculations (running total, percent of parent, versus first).
Filter pane and sort options don't offer the visual calculation.
Export data: the column is missing.
There's no copy/paste of a visual calculation to another visual.
RELATED, RELATEDTABLE and USERELATIONSHIP aren't available inside visual calculations.
mod-viscalc-2.check: All four limitations confirmed (per Microsoft's considerations and limitations list).
